Tymofii,

You closed the loop on two questions in the same thread, and you gave us a
distinction we have since used more than anything else from that exchange:
*reference by pin, not host*, with criteria marked as authored judgment rather
than recomputed fact.

We used it and did not tell you. Nineteen days. Sorry.

**Where it landed.** Our rubric header now carries two separate lines, because
your distinction made it obvious that one line was a lie:
